newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle light $67, off $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle light $67, off $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Thursday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt lower. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 600 slaughter steers and 600 heifers; 89,500 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 8 loads or 300 head CME cattle delivered to area packing plants, 15,000 head formulated and 800 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.

Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 67.00. Confirmed - 1,200
